verses.text: Ix smolb'ej sb'a masanil heb' israel, ix b'at lolon heb' yet' winhaj David t'a Hebrón. Ix yalan heb' t'a winh icha tik: Ha honh tik, junnhej ko mam kicham het'ok.

Ha t'a yalanhtaxo wach'chom ha winhaj Saúl ayoch reyal, palta ha hach ix honh ha kuchb'ej ayik ix kak'an owal. Hanhejtona', ix yal Jehová ko Diosal t'ayach to ha hach ol honh ha kuchb'ej, ol hach ochpaxkan ko reyalok, xchi heb' t'a winh.

Ayik ix k'och heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' Israel lolonel yet' winh t'a Hebrón chi', ix sb'o'an jun strato winh yet' heb' t'a yichanh Jehová. Hata' ix ak'jik'e aceite t'a sjolom winh yik tz'ochkan winh sreyalok Israel, icha wal tas scheknak Jehová yal winhaj Samuel.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj rey David chi' yet' masanil heb' yetisraelal t'a Jerusalén, skuchan pax Jebús, b'aj kajan heb' jebuseo.

Ix yalan heb' jebuseo chi' t'a winh icha tik: Ha hach tik, manh ol yal-laj ochta t'a tik, xchi heb' t'a winh. Palta ix ak'ji ganar scuartel heb' t'a tzalan Sion chi' yuj winh, yuj chi' ix skuchkan schonhab' winhaj David.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha mach ol b'ab'lajoch yak' owal yet' heb' jebuseo tik, ol wak'och yajalilok heb' soldado, xchi winh. Haxo winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarvia ix b'ab'laji, yuj chi' ix och winh yajalilok heb' soldado chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix kajnaj winhaj rey David t'a cuartel t'a Sion chi', yuj chi' Schonhab' Winhaj David ix sb'i'ejkani.
Ix sb'ok'e juntzanhxo pat winh t'a spatiktak chi', ix schab'at t'a ch'olan masanto ix k'och t'a smuro'al chonhab'. Haxo winhaj Joab ix wach' b'o'an stz'akub' chonhab' Jebús chi'.
Ix yik'an stek'anil yopisio winhaj rey David chi', yujto ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil aynhejoch yet' winh.

Ha heb' winh soldado winhaj rey David te b'inajnak, ix och heb' winh yet' masanil heb' yetisraelal ayik ix yak'anoch winhaj David chi' heb' reyal t'a yol smakb'en Israel smasanil. Ix te och wal heb' winh yet' winh yik syak'an reyal winh icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová.

Haton slista'il heb' winh soldado winhaj rey David te b'inajnak chi': Ha winhaj Jasobeam yuninal winhaj Hacmoni, sat yaj winh t'a skal oxwanhxo heb' winh yetb'inajnakil chi'. Ha t'a jun'el ix smilcham 300 heb' winh winak winh yet' k'e'en slanza.
Haxo junxo winh t'a skal heb' winh oxwanh chi', haton winhaj Eleazar yuninal winhaj Dodo, yinhtilal winhaj Aho.

Ha t'a jun'el ayek' winh yet' winhaj rey David t'a Pas-damim ayik ix smolb'an sb'a heb' filisteo yak' owal ta'. Hata' ay jun munlajel b'aj awab'il ixim cebada. Ayik ix el lemnaj heb' soldado Israel t'a yichanh heb' filisteo,

haxo heb' winh chawanh chi' ix kan tek'naj t'a skal jun munlajel chi', yik syak'an owal heb' winh. Ix ak'ji ganar heb' filisteo chi' yuj heb' winh. Icha chi' ix aj skolchajkan chonhab' Israel yuj Jehová.

Ha t'a jun'el, ha oxwanh heb' winh soldado te b'inajnak chi', ix b'at heb' winh t'a sattak k'e'en yik b'at schalan sb'a heb' winh yet' winhaj rey David t'a jun k'e'en nhak'e'en skuchan Adulam. Haxo heb' filisteo ay scampamento heb' t'a sch'olanil Refaim.
Ayik ayek' winhaj David t'a k'e'en nhak'e'en chi', ayek' scampamento heb' filisteo t'a Belén.
Yujto ste takji sti' winhaj David chi', yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: Komonok ha ha ha' ay t'a sti'el chonhab' Belén swuk'ej, xchi winh.

Haxo oxwanh heb' winh soldado te b'inajnak chi', ix och heb' winh t'a scampamento heb' filisteo, ix b'at yik'anelta ha ha' heb' winh t'a ha' uk'b'ila' t'a sti'el chonhab' Belén chi', ix yik'ankot ha' heb' winh t'a winhaj David chi'. Palta maj yal-laj sk'o'ol winh ix yuk'ej ha', tonhej ix sekem ha' winh t'a sat lu'um silab'il t'a Jehová.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Mokab' scha Dios wuk' ha ha' tik. Ichato ha' schik'il heb' winh tik swuk'ej tato swuk' ha', yujto ix sb'ek sb'a heb' winh schami yik ix b'at yik'ankot ha' heb' winh, xchi winh. Yuj chi' maj yuk'ejlaj ha' winh. Haton jun tik ix sk'ulej heb' winh oxwanh te b'inajnak chi'.

Ha winhaj Abisai yuktak winhaj Joab, yajal yaj winh t'a 30-xo heb' winh te b'inajnak. Ha t'a jun pekti', ix smilcham 300 winak winh yet' k'e'en slanza. Icha wal chi' ix aj yik'an sb'inajnakil winh t'a skal heb' winh 30 chi'.
Yuj chi' te niwan ix aj yelk'och winh t'a yichanh heb' winh chi'. Ix och winh yajalok heb' winh, palta maj k'ek'och winh icha heb' winh oxwanh b'ab'el chi'.

Ha winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj Joiada aj chonhab' Cabseel, te b'inajnak pax winh, tzijtum tas ix sk'ulej winh. Ha winh ix milancham chawanh soldado yuninal winhaj Ariel aj Moab. Haxo t'a jun'el ayik te ay k'e'en sakb'akom, ix em winh t'a yol jun jul. Hata' ix smilcham jun nok' choj winh.

Hanhejtona' ix smilcham jun winh aj Egipto winh. Nanhal am yoxil metro ste'el winh aj Egipto chi', haxo ste'al k'e'en slanza winh yet'nak, niwan spatik. Palta ha winhaj Benaía chi' anhej jun te te' yet'nak winh. Ix yik'ek' k'e'en slanza winh aj Egipto chi' winh, haxo yet' k'e'en slanza winh chi', ix smilcham winh.
Ha yuj juntzanh tas ix sk'ulej winh chi' ix yik' wal sb'inajnakil winh icha heb' winh oxwanh b'ab'el b'inajnak chi'.
Niwan ix aj sb'inaj winh t'a yichanh heb' winh 30 chi', palta maj k'ochlaj icha heb' winh oxwanh chi'. Ix ak'ji'och winhaj Benaía chi' yuj winhaj rey David yajalilok heb' stanhwumal.
Ha heb' winh 30 b'inajnak chi', haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Asael yuktak winhaj Joab, winhaj Elhanán yuninal winhaj Dodo aj Belén,
winhaj Samot aj Harod, winhaj Heles aj Pelón,
winhaj Ira yuninal winhaj Iques aj Tecoa, winhaj Abiezer aj Anatot,
winhaj Sibecai aj Husa, winhaj Ilai aj Aho,
winhaj Maharai aj Netofa, winhaj Heled yuninal winhaj Baana aj Netofa paxi,
winhaj Itai yuninal winhaj Ribai aj Gabaa ay t'a yol yik Benjamín, winhaj Benaía aj Piratón,
winhaj Hurai kajan t'a sti' ha' Gaas, winhaj Abiel aj Arba,
winhaj Azmavet aj Bahurim, winhaj Eliaba aj Saalbón,
heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jasén aj Gizón, winhaj Jonatán yuninal winhaj Sage aj Harar,
winhaj Ahíam yuninal winhaj Sacar aj Harar paxi, winhaj Elifal yuninal winhaj Ur,
winhaj Hefer aj Mequera, winhaj Ahías aj Pelón,
winhaj Hezro aj Carmel, winhaj Naarai yuninal winhaj Ezbai,
winhaj Joel yuktak winhaj Natán, winhaj Mibhar yuninal winhaj Hagrai,
winhaj Selec aj Amón, winhaj Naharai aj Berot. Ha jun winh chi' et'jinak syamk'ab' winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarvia,
winhaj Ira aj Itra, winhaj Gareb aj Itra paxi,
winhaj Urías hitita, winhaj Zabad yuninal winhaj Ahlai,
winhaj Adina yuninal winhaj Siza, yinhtilal Rubén, yajal yaj winh t'a skal heb' yinhtilal chi', 30 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh,
winhaj Hanán yuninal winhaj Maaca, winhaj Josafat aj Mitán,
winhaj Uzías aj Astarot, winhaj Sama yet' winhaj Jehiel, heb' winh yuninal winhaj Hotam aj Aroer,
winhaj Jediael yuninal winhaj Simri yet' winhaj Joha yuktak winh, aj Tiza heb' winh,
winhaj Eliel aj Mahab, winhaj Jerebai yet' winhaj Josavía. Ha heb' winh tik yuninal heb' winh winhaj Elnaam, winhaj Itma aj Moab,
winhaj Eliel, winhaj Obed yet' winhaj Jaasiel, aj Soba heb' winh.
